title: For all women and girls
discussion_signal: UN Women’s post highlights that women remain underrepresented in national leadership and frames representation in political decision-making as both an equality issue and a governance-quality issue.
linked_research_question: Why can women’s political representation advance slowly while executive power, parliamentary leadership, and safety remain sharply unequal?
limits: The post gives headline representation figures without explaining causal mechanisms
It does not measure hostility, violence, or quota implementation in detail
Institutional advocacy framing may not capture opposing public arguments
